celestrakParity.label: independent raw-vs-fit element-space parity (same NASA ISS OEM, same epoch)

tolerances.note: A2.4: element-space parity vs the SAME-EPOCH CelesTrak ISS-E SupGP OMM (captured 2026-07-13, NORAD 25544, [Segment 01] EPOCH 2026-07-13T12:00:00 == our fit epoch, Δepoch 0s). This is INDEPENDENT raw-vs-fit parity: both we and CelesTrak fit the same NASA public ISS OEM. Observed deltas (our fit vs CelesTrak Segment 01): meanMotion 2.6e-5, eccentricity 4e-7, inclination 0.0008deg, RAAN 0.0005deg, arg-lat(argp+MA) 0.0005deg — tolerances set ~8-100x above observed. RMS: ours 0.080 km vs CelesTrak 0.067 km — we do NOT beat CelesTrak's per-6h-segment RMS (our EME2000->TEME uses truncated 10-term nutation, ~13 m position error, A2.2a residual), so the hard beatsCelestrak RMS gate is NOT claimed for ISS; the element-space parity above is the honest gate. argp/MA compared as arg-lat (near-circular).
